notes.title: Game Price Dropped Down
notes.content:
We would like to announce that the game price dropped by [b]42%[/b].

[b]Why is that?[/b]
We decided to drop the game price cause we've been receiving a lot of feedback that game is overpriced and the price is not relevant to the current game state and it's gameplay length. We've been thinking about this a lot and we hope we made a right step.
By this way, we would like to apologize for the further misunderstandings. We would like to be very fair to our players and we would like to say THANK YOU for every support we've received yet. We will do our best to make the game even more entertaining and we hope we didn't lose you with the game price drop!
We've made a mistake at the beginning and as far as we know, there's always a way to learn from it.

Thank you for your understanding and we hope, you will stay with us.
[b]Yahart [/b]team & [b]Struct9 [/b]team
[url=https://astrotourvr.com]https://astrotourvr.com[/url]

notes.title: Astrotour VR - Future Content?
notes.content:
[b]Future Content?[/b]
Astrotour VR is now finally available on the Stream and we would like to announce that there will be much more than just planets exploration and hanging around the offices! In the future, we would like to add more features of enjoying the space adventure in much modular way rather than linear. Also we very welcome every suggestion and report that will make the game even better.

[b]Accessibility & Current State[/b]
The game is currently available on the Viveport and Steam, but we also plan Oculus Home release and Oculus Quest, which unexpectedly takes a bit longer! Soon, you will be able to play the Astrotour VR anytime and anywhere. We believe that Quest technology is more than progressive which guarantee another level of gameplay. AstrotourVR is a completed game, but we would like to add more content (the way of exploring the 'non-landable' planets, interactive features, easter-eggs etc) in the future. Not regularly.

[b]Next Steps[/b]
We plan to release minor patches (depending on your feedback) according to the overall gameplay, objects accessibility and performance. Our goal is to educate player, but mostly entertain! For now, you can enjoy linear gameplay of exploring each room and every planet. If you have any suggestions, issues or feedback, do not hesitate and write down in 'discussions' category. We hope, you will be satisfied with the AstrotourVR and you can look forward to the new adventure expansion. Big Thanks to all players!

[b]Yahart [/b]team & [b]Struct9 [/b]team

notes.title: Astrotour VR is now available!
notes.content:

If you face any problem, do not hesitate and post a message in Community Forum.
